card.name: Rule-stating verbs and objects
card.fires_on: Scattered single words in sentences that state a rule, requirement or procedure, such as 'who', 'for', 'an', 'reuse' or 'NEVER TOUCH'. The marked word is often a verb, article or preposition that comes just before the object of the rule.

modes.label: Warnings about needles
modes.description: Capitalized or 'never' warnings in injection device instructions, on the word after NEVER.
modes.example: CAUTION NEVER<< TOUCH>> OR TRY TO OPEN THE GREEN NEEDLE

modes.label: Laws and rules in general text
modes.description: Words inside descriptions of laws, oaths or scoring rules, just before what is required or allowed.
modes.example: This law provided that aliens to the United States could apply<< for>> citizenship provided that they were “free white
